title: Tech Lead Plataforma e SRE
description:
O Mercado Eletrônico é líder na América Latina em soluções de gestão de compras B2B. Suas tecnologias e serviços para as áreas de compras ajudam empresas a conquistarem mais economia, agilidade, governança e colaboração.

Com escritórios no Brasil, Estados Unidos, México e Portugal, contabiliza mais de 1 milhão de fornecedores, 10 mil compradores e transaciona um valor acima de R$ 160 bilhões em negócios anualmente. É a única empresa latino-americana a fazer parte do Quadrante Mágico S2P (source-to-pay), do Gartner.


Tech Lead - Plataforma e SRE

contratação CLT


Gosta de desafios técnicos de alta complexidade, arquitetura escalável e resolver problemas de infraestrutura em escala? Aqui você vai liderar tecnicamente soluções em Kubernetes, observabilidade de ponta, automação e práticas modernas de SRE, garantindo alta disponibilidade e performance dos nossos sistemas.


Quais serão suas responsabilidades neste desafio?

  • Liderar tecnicamente a arquitetura e evolução da plataforma, definindo padrões e boas práticas de SRE e DevOps.
  • Projetar e implementar soluções resilientes, escaláveis e de alta disponibilidade em ambientes cloud e híbridos.
  • Definir e implementar estratégias de CI/CD, automação e Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Estabelecer práticas de observabilidade, definir SLOs e implementar monitoramento avançado (Prometheus, Grafana LGTM, OpenTelemetry).
  • Otimizar performance, reduzir MTTR e atuar na resolução de incidentes críticos com análise de causa raiz.
  • Automatizar processos operacionais e de infraestrutura (IaC, pipelines, deploys).
  • Assegurar práticas de DevSecOps, implementando segurança desde o desenvolvimento até a produção.
  • Disseminar conhecimento técnico e promover boas práticas no time através de code reviews, RFCs e documentação técnica.
  • Gerenciar custos e otimizar recursos na nuvem.


Será bacana se você tiver:

  • Experiência sólida com práticas de SRE e alta disponibilidade.
  • Experiência avançada em Cloud (AWS, OCI ou multi-cloud) e ambientes híbridos.
  • Experiência avançada com Linux e administração de sistemas.
  • Domínio de Kubernetes, containers e orquestração (Docker, Helm, etc.).
  • Proficiência em Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible ou similares).
  • Experiência com CI/CD moderno (GitLab, ArgoCD, Jenkins ou similares).
  • Forte conhecimento em observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana LGTM, OTel, ELK).
  • Automação e scripting avançado (Python, Go ou Bash/Shell).
  • Práticas de DevSecOps e segurança em nuvem.
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas de alto impacto e arquiteturais.
  • Comunicação técnica eficaz para interação com times multidisciplinares.
  • Perfil analítico e resolutivo para troubleshooting e otimização de sistemas complexos.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Chaos Engineering e testes de resiliência.
  • Vivência com FinOps e otimização de custos na nuvem.

title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples that models might get wrong, and You would articulate the correct answer & explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills.
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: UGC Coordinator
description:
UGC Coordinator


About Us:

We are a DTC company who creates direct response ads. Our marketing team makes scripts for ads that sometimes needs UGC creators to film them. This is how you will fit into our company.


About the Role

We’re looking for a UGC Coordinator to own and lead our creator operations end-to-end. 

This role is critical to keeping our content engine moving: sourcing top-tier creators, managing relationships, anticipating roadblocks, negotiating UGC costs, and ensuring deliverables flow smoothly from concept to edit-ready.


You’ll be the point person between creators, Creative Strategists, and Operations , bringing structure, clarity, and momentum to a high-volume, fast-moving environment. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on organization, takes initiative, and solves problems independently.


Key Responsibilities
  • Own the full creator lifecycle, from sourcing and vetting to delivery and payment


  • Build and maintain strong relationships with creators, ensuring clear expectations, timelines, and communication


  • Act as the operational hub for all creator-related projects, keeping internal tools (Notion, Slack, etc) accurate, up to date, and easy to understand at a glance


  • Proactively track progress across all concepts and creators, identifying risks, delays, or gaps before they escalate


  • Coordinate closely with Creative Strategists to ensure creators are fully aligned on briefs, constraints, and deliverables


  • Ensure seamless handoff of content to post-production, with well-organized assets and clear documentation


  • Handle reshoots, revisions, and edge cases with a solution-first mindset


  • Manage & negotiate creator payments and documentation in a timely and organized manner


What Success Looks Like
  • Anyone opening our tracking systems can instantly understand the status of every creator and deliverable


  • Creators feel supported, informed, and motivated to deliver high-quality content on time


  • Issues are flagged early, communicated clearly, and resolved efficiently


  • Content moves forward without bottlenecks, confusion, or last-minute fire drills


Required Qualities
  • Highly organized : able to manage multiple creators, timelines, and deliverables simultaneously


  • Proactive and accountable : you don’t wait to be asked—you move things forward


  • Problem-solver : able to find creative solutions independently before escalating


  • Strong communicator : clear, concise, and professional across Slack, email, and documentation


  • Detail-oriented but execution-focused : you balance precision with speed


Experience & Background
  • Proven experience working with creators, talent, or influencers (UGC content preferred)


  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-output environment


  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with creative, operations, and production teams



Why This Role Matters

This role is central to how our creative machine runs. As a UGC coordinator, you ensure that ideas turn into real, usable content—on time, organized, and ready to perform. Your work directly impacts creative velocity, team alignment, and overall results.



Compensation & Perks:

Base Salary from $2,000-$3,250 USD per month

Full-Time, 40 hours per week (Flexible Schedule just a few hours overlap with EST is fine)

Fully Remote

Time Zone: EST

title: Electrical BIM Lead
description:
At Eracore, we’re committed to developing talented engineers and exposing them to some of the most exciting electrical projects in the country, while becoming the most trusted partners in the industry. From coordination and prefabrication to detailed shop drawings, we support some of the most complex and high-stakes electrical projects in the United States, including Data Centers, Government Facilities, Manufacturing Plants, and cutting-edge Commercial developments.


Under strong leadership, Eracore is quickly expanding their presence in Brazil . Our goal is to develop a team of the brightest minds to take on the biggest industry challenges on some of the coolest projects in the USA.


Visit our site to see some of our projects that we want you to be a part of -->


Benefits of working with us:

  • Competitive Salary
  • Annual Bonus
  • Learning platforms that enable growth and development
  • Strong leadership and mentorship


Roles and Responsibilities

  • Oversee and lead the development, coordination, and delivery of Electrical BIM models across all project stages, ensuring compliance with project requirements, standards, and industry best practices.
  • Manage and guide the Electrical BIM team by providing technical support, quality checks, and mentorship to ensure accurate and efficient model development.
  • Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams (Mechanical, Architectural, Structural, and other engineering teams) to ensure effective model coordination and clash-free deliverables.
  • Conduct regular model audits, data checks, and quality control reviews to ensure the integrity and reliability of electrical BIM deliverables.
  • Prepare and deliver BIM-related documentation, including model execution plans, progress reports, schedules, and technical presentations.
  • Support the integration of BIM with other digital tools such as Navisworks, Revit and clash detection software for enhanced project delivery.
  • Identify process gaps and propose improvements to enhance BIM efficiency, model accuracy, and team productivity.
  • Train and upskill team members on BIM technologies, electrical modeling techniques, and emerging industry trends.
  • Coordinate with client BIM teams to understand project expectations, provide updates, and ensure smooth communication throughout the project lifecycle.


Qualifications

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in Electrical BIM modeling, coordination, and project delivery.
  • Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit (Electrical discipline) with strong understanding of electrical systems
  • Strong experience using Navisworks for clash detection, coordination, and model review.
  • Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, Bluebeam, and other industry tools.
  • Proven ability to lead, mentor, and guide juniors while maintaining high-quality output.
  • Ability to manage project timelines and client expectations.


Preferrable

  • Solid understanding of U.S. construction practices, NEC codes, and electrical engineering principle.
  • Experience in developing BIM standards, workflows, and templates for electrical systems.
  • Prior experience working on Data Centers.

title: UGC Coordinator
description:
UGC Coordinator


About Us:

We are a DTC company who creates direct response ads. Our marketing team makes scripts for ads that sometimes needs UGC creators to film them. This is how you will fit into our company.


About the Role

We’re looking for a UGC Coordinator to own and lead our creator operations end-to-end. 

This role is critical to keeping our content engine moving: sourcing top-tier creators, managing relationships, anticipating roadblocks, negotiating UGC costs, and ensuring deliverables flow smoothly from concept to edit-ready.


You’ll be the point person between creators, Creative Strategists, and Operations , bringing structure, clarity, and momentum to a high-volume, fast-moving environment. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on organization, takes initiative, and solves problems independently.


Key Responsibilities
  • Own the full creator lifecycle, from sourcing and vetting to delivery and payment


  • Build and maintain strong relationships with creators, ensuring clear expectations, timelines, and communication


  • Act as the operational hub for all creator-related projects, keeping internal tools (Notion, Slack, etc) accurate, up to date, and easy to understand at a glance


  • Proactively track progress across all concepts and creators, identifying risks, delays, or gaps before they escalate


  • Coordinate closely with Creative Strategists to ensure creators are fully aligned on briefs, constraints, and deliverables


  • Ensure seamless handoff of content to post-production, with well-organized assets and clear documentation


  • Handle reshoots, revisions, and edge cases with a solution-first mindset


  • Manage & negotiate creator payments and documentation in a timely and organized manner


What Success Looks Like
  • Anyone opening our tracking systems can instantly understand the status of every creator and deliverable


  • Creators feel supported, informed, and motivated to deliver high-quality content on time


  • Issues are flagged early, communicated clearly, and resolved efficiently


  • Content moves forward without bottlenecks, confusion, or last-minute fire drills


Required Qualities
  • Highly organized : able to manage multiple creators, timelines, and deliverables simultaneously


  • Proactive and accountable : you don’t wait to be asked—you move things forward


  • Problem-solver : able to find creative solutions independently before escalating


  • Strong communicator : clear, concise, and professional across Slack, email, and documentation


  • Detail-oriented but execution-focused : you balance precision with speed


Experience & Background
  • Proven experience working with creators, talent, or influencers (UGC content preferred)


  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-output environment


  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with creative, operations, and production teams



Why This Role Matters

This role is central to how our creative machine runs. As a UGC coordinator, you ensure that ideas turn into real, usable content—on time, organized, and ready to perform. Your work directly impacts creative velocity, team alignment, and overall results.



Compensation & Perks:

Base Salary from $2,000-$3,250 USD per month

Full-Time, 40 hours per week (Flexible Schedule just a few hours overlap with EST is fine)

Fully Remote

Time Zone: EST

title: Electrical BIM Lead
description:
At Eracore, we’re committed to developing talented engineers and exposing them to some of the most exciting electrical projects in the country, while becoming the most trusted partners in the industry. From coordination and prefabrication to detailed shop drawings, we support some of the most complex and high-stakes electrical projects in the United States, including Data Centers, Government Facilities, Manufacturing Plants, and cutting-edge Commercial developments.


Under strong leadership, Eracore is quickly expanding their presence in Brazil . Our goal is to develop a team of the brightest minds to take on the biggest industry challenges on some of the coolest projects in the USA.


Visit our site to see some of our projects that we want you to be a part of -->

  • Prior experience working on Data Centers.

title: Manager / Senior Manager, FP&A
description:
Manager / Senior Manager, FP&A


Location: Brazil (Remote)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. For one of our clients , a mid-sized company operating at scale, we are currently looking to hire a Manager / Senior Manager, FP&A .


About the Role


This is a hands-on FP&A role in a flat organization. While the right candidate may have a direct report in the future, this position requires a strong individual contributor who is comfortable owning analyses end to end.

We are looking for someone who is detail-oriented, highly analytical, and action-driven , with the ability to influence business decisions through financial insights.


Key Responsibilities


Build and maintain 3-statement financial models , with a strong understanding of how they flow together

Develop financial models from scratch, including ROI analysis and scenario modeling

Prepare monthly and quarterly financial review decks , clearly explaining business performance using financial storytelling and waterfall analyses

Partner with leadership to identify opportunities to improve revenue, margins, and overall P&L performance

Support PE-related reporting and ad-hoc analyses

  • Help establish and improve FP&A best-practice processes in an evolving environment


Required Experience & Skills


5+ years of FP&A experience , ideally within a Fortune 500 environment

Experience in mid-sized companies is a strong plus

Strong understanding of 3-statement financial modeling

Advanced Excel skills (heavy modeling role; keyboard-driven workflows preferred)

Experience creating executive-level PowerPoint presentations with clear financial narratives

  • Experience with IBM Cognos / TM1 is a plus
  • Tableau experience is a plus, but not required
  • Private Equity experience is highly preferred


What We’re Looking For


  • Comfortable working in ambiguous, less structured environments
  • Independent and able to take ownership of projects from start to finish

Intellectually curious and proactive in asking the right questions

  • Strong bias for action , with a proven ability to challenge the status quo using data


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.


Your applicaton will only be taken into consideration if your resume is in English!

title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples that models might get wrong, and You would articulate the correct answer & explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples that models might get wrong, and You would articulate the correct answer & explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.

title: Manager / Senior Manager, FP&A
description:
Manager / Senior Manager, FP&A


Location: Brazil (Remote)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. For one of our clients , a mid-sized company operating at scale, we are currently looking to hire a Manager / Senior Manager, FP&A .


About the Role


This is a hands-on FP&A role in a flat organization. While the right candidate may have a direct report in the future, this position requires a strong individual contributor who is comfortable owning analyses end to end.

We are looking for someone who is detail-oriented, highly analytical, and action-driven , with the ability to influence business decisions through financial insights.


Key Responsibilities


Build and maintain 3-statement financial models , with a strong understanding of how they flow together

Develop financial models from scratch, including ROI analysis and scenario modeling

Prepare monthly and quarterly financial review decks , clearly explaining business performance using financial storytelling and waterfall analyses

Partner with leadership to identify opportunities to improve revenue, margins, and overall P&L performance

Support PE-related reporting and ad-hoc analyses

  • Help establish and improve FP&A best-practice processes in an evolving environment


Required Experience & Skills


5+ years of FP&A experience , ideally within a Fortune 500 environment

Experience in mid-sized companies is a strong plus

Strong understanding of 3-statement financial modeling

Advanced Excel skills (heavy modeling role; keyboard-driven workflows preferred)

Experience creating executive-level PowerPoint presentations with clear financial narratives

  • Experience with IBM Cognos / TM1 is a plus
  • Tableau experience is a plus, but not required
  • Private Equity experience is highly preferred


What We’re Looking For


  • Comfortable working in ambiguous, less structured environments
  • Independent and able to take ownership of projects from start to finish

Intellectually curious and proactive in asking the right questions

  • Strong bias for action , with a proven ability to challenge the status quo using data


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.


Your applicaton will only be taken into consideration if your resume is in English!

title: UGC Coordinator
description:
UGC Coordinator


About Us:

We are a DTC company who creates direct response ads. Our marketing team makes scripts for ads that sometimes needs UGC creators to film them. This is how you will fit into our company.


About the Role

We’re looking for a UGC Coordinator to own and lead our creator operations end-to-end. 

This role is critical to keeping our content engine moving: sourcing top-tier creators, managing relationships, anticipating roadblocks, negotiating UGC costs, and ensuring deliverables flow smoothly from concept to edit-ready.


You’ll be the point person between creators, Creative Strategists, and Operations , bringing structure, clarity, and momentum to a high-volume, fast-moving environment. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on organization, takes initiative, and solves problems independently.


Key Responsibilities
  • Own the full creator lifecycle, from sourcing and vetting to delivery and payment


  • Build and maintain strong relationships with creators, ensuring clear expectations, timelines, and communication


  • Act as the operational hub for all creator-related projects, keeping internal tools (Notion, Slack, etc) accurate, up to date, and easy to understand at a glance


  • Proactively track progress across all concepts and creators, identifying risks, delays, or gaps before they escalate


  • Coordinate closely with Creative Strategists to ensure creators are fully aligned on briefs, constraints, and deliverables


  • Ensure seamless handoff of content to post-production, with well-organized assets and clear documentation


  • Handle reshoots, revisions, and edge cases with a solution-first mindset


  • Manage & negotiate creator payments and documentation in a timely and organized manner


What Success Looks Like
  • Anyone opening our tracking systems can instantly understand the status of every creator and deliverable


  • Creators feel supported, informed, and motivated to deliver high-quality content on time


  • Issues are flagged early, communicated clearly, and resolved efficiently


  • Content moves forward without bottlenecks, confusion, or last-minute fire drills


Required Qualities
  • Highly organized : able to manage multiple creators, timelines, and deliverables simultaneously


  • Proactive and accountable : you don’t wait to be asked—you move things forward


  • Problem-solver : able to find creative solutions independently before escalating


  • Strong communicator : clear, concise, and professional across Slack, email, and documentation


  • Detail-oriented but execution-focused : you balance precision with speed


Experience & Background
  • Proven experience working with creators, talent, or influencers (UGC content preferred)


  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-output environment


  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with creative, operations, and production teams



Why This Role Matters

This role is central to how our creative machine runs. As a UGC coordinator, you ensure that ideas turn into real, usable content—on time, organized, and ready to perform. Your work directly impacts creative velocity, team alignment, and overall results.



Compensation & Perks:

Base Salary from $2,000-$3,250 USD per month

Full-Time, 40 hours per week (Flexible Schedule just a few hours overlap with EST is fine)

Fully Remote

Time Zone: EST

title: Electrical BIM Lead
description:
At Eracore, we’re committed to developing talented engineers and exposing them to some of the most exciting electrical projects in the country, while becoming the most trusted partners in the industry. From coordination and prefabrication to detailed shop drawings, we support some of the most complex and high-stakes electrical projects in the United States, including Data Centers, Government Facilities, Manufacturing Plants, and cutting-edge Commercial developments.


Under strong leadership, Eracore is quickly expanding their presence in Brazil . Our goal is to develop a team of the brightest minds to take on the biggest industry challenges on some of the coolest projects in the USA.


Visit our site to see some of our projects that we want you to be a part of -->


Benefits of working with us:

  • Competitive Salary
  • Annual Bonus
  • Learning platforms that enable growth and development
  • Strong leadership and mentorship


Roles and Responsibilities

  • Oversee and lead the development, coordination, and delivery of Electrical BIM models across all project stages, ensuring compliance with project requirements, standards, and industry best practices.
  • Manage and guide the Electrical BIM team by providing technical support, quality checks, and mentorship to ensure accurate and efficient model development.
  • Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams (Mechanical, Architectural, Structural, and other engineering teams) to ensure effective model coordination and clash-free deliverables.
  • Conduct regular model audits, data checks, and quality control reviews to ensure the integrity and reliability of electrical BIM deliverables.
  • Prepare and deliver BIM-related documentation, including model execution plans, progress reports, schedules, and technical presentations.
  • Support the integration of BIM with other digital tools such as Navisworks, Revit and clash detection software for enhanced project delivery.
  • Identify process gaps and propose improvements to enhance BIM efficiency, model accuracy, and team productivity.
  • Train and upskill team members on BIM technologies, electrical modeling techniques, and emerging industry trends.
  • Coordinate with client BIM teams to understand project expectations, provide updates, and ensure smooth communication throughout the project lifecycle.


Qualifications

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in Electrical BIM modeling, coordination, and project delivery.
  • Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit (Electrical discipline) with strong understanding of electrical systems
  • Strong experience using Navisworks for clash detection, coordination, and model review.
  • Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, Bluebeam, and other industry tools.
  • Proven ability to lead, mentor, and guide juniors while maintaining high-quality output.
  • Ability to manage project timelines and client expectations.


Preferrable

  • Solid understanding of U.S. construction practices, NEC codes, and electrical engineering principle.
  • Experience in developing BIM standards, workflows, and templates for electrical systems.
  • Prior experience working on Data Centers.

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Initiative and creativity

title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples that models might get wrong, and You would articulate the correct answer & explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills.
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: ESPECIALISTA EM DESENVOLVIMENTO DE SOFTWARE (IoT & Event Streaming) | Remoto
description:
Sobre a Localiza | Mobi7

A Mobi7 é a unidade de soluções de telemetria e IoT da Localiza, líder em mobilidade na América Latina. Nossa missão é transformar dados em inteligência para veículos conectados, com tecnologia de ponta e alta performance.


Estamos buscando um(a) Especialista em Desenvolvimento de Software para atuar no desenvolvimento de microserviços event-driven de alta performance , processando dados em tempo real de dispositivos IoT instalados em veículos. Você fará parte de um time que constrói soluções escaláveis, resilientes e observáveis, usando uma stack moderna e práticas avançadas de engenharia.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver microserviços event-driven com Java 21+ , Spring Boot 3.5+ e Spring Cloud Stream .
  • Implementar pipelines de streaming de eventos com Apache Kafka (MSK), garantindo Exactly-Once Semantics , DLQ e particionamento eficiente.
  • Criar e evoluir contratos de dados com Avro e Schema Registry .
  • Otimizar persistência em PostgreSQL e cache distribuído com Redis .
  • Garantir observabilidade avançada com Datadog APM , logs estruturados e métricas customizadas.
  • Atuar em ambiente AWS (ECS Fargate, MSK, CloudWatch) com práticas DevOps e CI/CD.


Requisitos e qualificações

Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida atuando com Java (Spring Boot).
  • Domínio avançado de Apache Kafka .
  • Experiência com AWS (ECS, Parameter Store, CloudWatch).
  • Proficiência em testes automatizados (JUnit, Testcontainers).


Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com Kotlin 2.x .
  • Conhecimento em Datadog APM , Avro , Liquibase .
  • Familiaridade com GraalVM Native Image .


Diferenciais:

  • Projetos open-source.
  • Certificação AWS.
  • Experiência com IoT/telemetria veicular.


BENEFÍCIOS DESSA POSIÇÃO:

  • Participação nos Lucros;
  • Carro Corporativo;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Convênio Médico;
  • Convênio Odontológico;
  • Reembolso de Despesas Médicas;
  • Wellhub;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Auxilio Home Office;
  • Allya;
  • Acesso ilimitado a diversos cursos da nossa Universidade Localiza;
  • Programas internos de treinamento e desenvolvimento;
  • Desconto em compra e aluguel de veículos.


Viva a experiência de ser Localiza&Co e venha construir o futuro da mobilidade conosco!

title: Strategic Executive Assistant to the CEO
description:
The Vision


At AI Leadership, we believe in clarity, structure, and well-run operations that allow our team to focus on the work that creates the greatest impact. The Strategic EA role exists to provide end-to-end leverage to the CEO by owning tactical and operational execution: inbox, calendar, logistics, and meeting prep. We are looking for a \"thinking partner\" who can maintain the highest standards of operational excellence and brand representation.


Who We’re Looking For


The Strategic Executive Assistant (EA) will act as the CEO's \"20% focus\" unlock, allowing him to drive 80% of business outcomes. This is not a role for someone who only follows rigid rules; we need an individual who can operate with nuance, anticipate needs before they are stated, and understand the CEO's unique decision-making framework.

You will be measured on your ability to triage the CEO's inbox to 95% without escalation and reduce calendar friction to near-zero. If you are a high-nuance individual who \"just gets it\" and thrives in a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.



Why You Should Join Us


  • AI Frontier : Gain direct exposure to the AI space and learn to build and refine AI-driven automation.
  • Career Growth : We are a growing organization that values internal mobility; this role has a path toward operations or management, as demonstrated by previous incumbents.
  • High-Impact Environment : Work alongside experienced leaders who prioritize growth, ambition, and proactive problem-solving.


Role Responsibilities


The 20% That Drives 80% of Success

  • Inbox Ownership : Manage the CEO's inbox end-to-end, responding to all messages within 24 hours using his tone and zero \"emotional leakage\".
  • Strategic Calendar Defense : Own the calendar to ensure it reflects strategic priorities; proactively identify gaps or blockers and coordinate with the family assistant to honor personal time.
  • Flawless Travel & Logistics : Execute end-to-end travel (flights, hotels, ground transport) and remain on-call for any transit issues.
  • Meeting Readiness : Maintain prep docs and ensure the CEO is fully prepared for every internal and external stakeholder interaction.

The Remaining 80%

  • HubSpot & CRM Maintenance : Review deals weekly, ensure follow-up tasks are executed on time, and load new contacts sourced by the CEO.
  • SOP & Notion Management : Fully own and update all CEO-related workflows and databases, ensuring documentation is audit-ready and searchable.
  • Small-Scope Project Management : Lead projects assigned by the Exec Ops Manager, assessing needs, developing plans, and communicating status to stakeholders.


Skills & Attributes We're Looking For


  • Methodical & Nuanced : You understand the difference between tactical execution and strategic decision-making and can operate independently in ambiguous situations.
  • 1–3 Years of Relevant Experience : Ideally supporting senior leaders or working in high-growth, corporate, or communications-heavy environments.
  • Proactive Tech-Savviness : Proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, HubSpot (or similar CRMs), and Notion, plus a strong drive to use AI tools for speed and efficiency.
  • Executive Presence : You have a professional audio/video setup and communicate with the polish required for CEO-facing interactions.
  • Coachability : You believe feedback is the \"breakfast of champions\" and iterate quickly based on guidance.


Our Values


  • Create remarkable experiences – Every interaction is a chance to satisfy customers and internal team members.
  • Always be growing – Committed to continuous improvement and individual learning.
  • Deliver results – Taking initiative to solve problems and drive success regardless of formal responsibility.
  • Do the right thing – Prioritizing integrity, respect, and discretion in all interactions.
  • Practice what we teach – Pushing the boundaries of what it means to be AI-driven.

Compensation & Location


  • Compensation : Starts at $2,200 USD
  • Location : Remote (Working within 8 AM - 5 PM CST is preferred).


Application & Selection Process


TO APPLY:

  • Send your Resume (PDF titled \"Lastname.Firstname.EA.pdf\") to (Operations+ ).
  • Record a short demo video (2 - 4 mins max) highlighting your relevant experience for the role, skills, successes, and goals for the future. Also, we’d like you to briefly mention the following insights: Process Optimization Proposal: Share an example of how you’ve improved an operational workflow in the past (Preferably using AI or automation tools). We want you to showcase your personality, and why you believe you are the ideal candidate for the Strategic Executive Assistant role.


Our process is thorough but rewarding. Here is what you can expect:

  • Technical AI Prompt Test and Strategic Thinking Exercise
  • Behavioral Assessments : Working Genius (to assess natural strengths) and Kolbe A Index.

Three-Step Interview sequence : Initial Screening call → Head of Operations → CEO.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (LATAM Only)
description:
Senior Full Stack Software Engineer

Location: Remote — Brazil/US time zones (EST ±3h) • Contract: International contractor, $35/hour • Language: English (fluent) • Reports to: CTO & Engineering team.



About the role

Volatus is hiring a Senior Fullstack Engineer to own critical product work on a next‑generation platform for fertility clinics and their patients. You will join as a founding engineer, shaping both the product and the technical direction in a category where better software directly improves patient outcomes.


Tech context

You will work in a modern, greenfield stack centered on:

  • Frontend: Next.js/React , Typescript , Tailwind CSS
  • Backend: Node.js/TypeScript with a PostgreSQL core (schema design, authN,authZ, performance, transactions, triggers).
  • Data & integrations: Third-party API integrations ; performance profiling (e.g., Lighthouse).
  • Quality: Unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; CI/CD .
  • Collaboration: Work closely with our Head of Engineering, Principal Engineer, Product Designer, and CEO.


What you will do

  • Build and ship end‑to‑end features across the Next.js frontend and Node/TypeScript backend. 
  • Model and tune Postgres schemas; ensure secure authN/authZ and strong performance. 
  • Integrate external APIs and improve app reliability and speed (including Lighthouse‑driven improvements). 
  • Write reliable tests (unit/integration/e2e) and contribute to CI/CD workflows. 
  • Make pragmatic early‑stage architectural decisions and raise the engineering bar.


What you will bring

  • Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate development and quality. 
  • Strong production experience with Next.js/React, Node.js, and TypeScript.
  • Tailwind & CSS mastery; responsive, accessible UI. 
  • PostgreSQL expertise (modeling, security/auth, performance, transactions, triggers). 
  • Integrations experience (third‑party APIs) and solid testing practice (unit/integration/e2e). 
  • Portfolio or links to shipped projects/code.


90-day outcomes

In your first 90 days, you will:

  • Lead at least one significant feature from design to production, used by real clinics or internal teams.​
  • Improve a key part of the frontend experience (e.g., performance, usability, or design consistency) and document the standards for others.​
  • Own part of the backend or data model, including at least one meaningful performance or reliability improvement.​
  • Help define or refine testing and deployment practices so the team can ship faster and with more confidence.


Nice to have

  • Experience building voice‑controlled components / speech‑to‑text. 
  • Experience interacting with AI models from the web app.


How we work

  • Remote within EST ±3 hours preferred ; open to other time zones if you can collaborate on US‑friendly hours.
  • Small, senior team with a strong bias toward action and ownership ;
  • Product-led culture : engineers are closely involved in discovery, tradeoff discussions, and shaping the roadmap.


Hiring process

  • Coderpad Challenge (60 min)
  • Intro chat (45 min) – mutual fit and role context.
  • Technical deep‑dive & Live testing – discuss systems you’ve built; pair on a focused problem (no whiteboard trivia).
  • Team conversation – meet engineering + product leadership.
  • References & offer.


Volatus is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

title: Customer Success Specialist, Life Sciences
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Responsibilities:


  • Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
  • Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
  • Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
  • Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources.
  • Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.


Requirements:


  • A Master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • 1-3 years of experience in customer facing roles is preferred.
  • Fluent communication skills English.
  • Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
  • Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.


Please share your resume in English.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

Atuação em projeto de migração de pipelines ETL do Informatica PowerCenter para AWS Glue, participando do desenvolvimento, modernização e sustentação de soluções de dados em ambiente cloud, garantindo qualidade, performance e aderência aos padrões técnicos do cliente.

Apoiar ou executar a migração de jobs ETL do PowerCenter para AWS Glue.

title: Senior Product Experience Designer (Remote) - B2B Healthtech SaaS
description:
• Ongoing contract role · 10 hours per week · Remote (Brazil Based)
  • Flexible hours · PST time zone overlap preferred
  • International team across Brazil and North America
  • 5+ years of designing SaaS web applications (required)
  • Hands-on product experience design - workflows, flows, wireframes
  • Fluent English required - written and spoken


About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Experience Designer to help shape the user experience of a SaaS web application platform that supports healthcare practitioners in delivering better patient outcomes.


This role is intentionally scoped at 10 hours per week , with some overlap during PST business hours required. It’s focused on senior-level product experience design - the kind of work where judgment, clarity, and good decisions matter.


This role is well suited to someone who:

  • enjoys focused, high-impact work,
  • may already have other professional commitments,
  • and values collaborating with a small, international team on meaningful product problems.


You’ll work closely with the founder and an experienced product, design, and development team to design end-to-end product experiences — from early concepts through to wireframes ready for visual design and implementation.


This is not a UI-polish role, and it’s not advisory. You will be designing the product experience itself.


About Optive

We build software that helps functional medicine and healthcare practitioners deliver better patient outcomes through clearer data, better insight, and more consistent follow-up care. Optive is the next stage of this work - a patient engagement and care platform designed to support ongoing, relationship-based healthcare rather than one-off interactions.


Our team works across two closely related platforms:

  • Optive - a patient engagement and care platform
  • Optimal DX - an established diagnostics and lab interpretation system used by practitioners today


You’ll contribute experience design work across both platforms , helping ensure coherence and clarity as the ecosystem evolves.


Our team is fully remote and international, working across Brazil and North America, with collaboration primarily across PST time zones - often a good fit for Brazil-based team members who prefer some evening overlap.



What You'll Do

  • Design end-to-end user journeys for complex SaaS web applications
  • Translate product goals into clear workflows, flows, and wireframes
  • Think through user intent, edge cases, and complexity vs. simplicity trade-offs
  • Create low-fidelity wireframes and experience diagrams (Figma, Miro, etc.)
  • Collaborate with a senior visual designer who will take your work into high-fidelity design
  • Challenge assumptions constructively and improve product clarity early - before development begins
  • Communicate clearly with an international team in English , both written and spoken


Why this Role Might be a Fit

  • Have 5+ years of experience designing customer-facing SaaS products or complex web applications
  • Have worked on products that real customers use in production
  • Are comfortable designing multi-step workflows and role-based experiences
  • Understand how UX decisions impact usability, adoption, and real-world outcomes
  • Prefer focused, senior-level contribution over full-time availability
  • Are comfortable working independently with a high level of trust
  • Can overlap some working hours with PST
  • Communicate fluently in English


Preferred Background

While we care far more about what you’ve designed and shipped than your exact job title, this role is best suited to someone who has:

  • Designed complex SaaS or web applications used in production
  • Owned or heavily influenced end-to-end product experiences , not just individual screens
  • Worked closely with founders, product leaders, or engineering teams in small to mid-sized software companies
  • Designed workflows where clarity, trust, and correctness matter (e.g. healthcare, fintech, B2B, or data-heavy products)
  • Been accountable for experience decisions that had real user and business impact


If your experience is primarily marketing sites, brand work, or UI-only execution, this role is unlikely to be a fit.


Proof Matters

We strongly prefer candidates who can show real work, such as:

  • Screenshots of shipped SaaS products
  • Annotated flows or wireframes
  • Case studies explaining experience design decisions
  • Clear examples of problems you personally solved


We understand NDAs exist — but we’re looking for people who can point to real experience design work and talk concretely about the decisions behind it.


How to Apply

Apply via LinkedIn.


Please include:

  • A short note about your experience designing SaaS or web applications
  • Links to relevant work (portfolio, screenshots, case studies)
  • Anything that clearly shows how you shaped the product experience


Applications without clear experience in SaaS or web-based product design will not be considered.

title: Sr. Product Analyst
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our flag ship product is a Chromium browser, that provides a powerful and secure way to search the web; and our growing ecosystem includes a portfolio of innovative mobile products. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Product Analyst to join our team and help drive data-informed decisions to help grow and optimize our browser products. This individual will play a critical role in analyzing user behavior, evaluating feature performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high quality data insights. This role is best suited for a confident self-starter and requires a blend of creative vision, technical know-how, strong communication / presentation skills, and exceptional organizational skills.


Key Responsibilities


Data Analysis, Insights, & Skills

  • Extract, clean, and analyze data using SQL to understand product performance, user behavior, and business trends
  • Proficient at using / analyzing excel, dashboards, reports, and KPIs to monitor product health/performance
  • Understands what constitutes “accuracy” for various data sets and can run checks to verify the accuracy of a data set
  • Automatically goes the “extra step” on assigned tasks.
  • Able to provide actionable recommendations to product managers and leadership teams
  • Capable of providing clear and concise write-ups for complex analysis
  • Capable of performing tasks with speed and efficiency


Personality Traits

  • People excel in this position that are self – starters, confident, and competitive
  • They are capable of self-management and independent decision making
  • They have strong time/priority management skills
  • They are team players and can see problems from multiple points of view.

title: Senior Tech Sourcer
description:
Senior Tech Sourcer


Summary

We’re looking for an experienced Tech Sourcer to join Kake’s internal team and help build our sourcing function from the ground up. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing and executing sourcing strategies for technical roles, partnering closely with recruiters, and building strong talent pipelines. If you enjoy deep sourcing, proactive outreach, and shaping scalable processes, we’d love to hear from you.


What You’ll Do

  • Partner with recruiters during role kick-offs to align on hiring needs, must-haves, dealbreakers, and sourcing strategy.
  • Own end-to-end technical sourcing for new roles, building and maintaining strong candidate pipelines.
  • Design and execute sourcing strategies using Boolean search, headhunting, talent mapping, and targeted company research.
  • Create tailored outreach messages to attract and engage high-quality technical candidates.
  • Conduct initial profile and pre-screening assessments, identifying fit, gaps, and potential risks early in the process.
  • Manage sourced candidates in the ATS, ensuring accurate tracking, stage updates, and smooth handoff to recruiters.
  • Maintain consistent communication with candidates, supporting scheduling and follow-ups when needed.
  • Contribute to building sourcing processes, best practices, and documentation as the function scales.


Core Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in technical sourcing or talent sourcing roles.
  • Strong experience sourcing for technical profiles across different stacks and seniority levels.
  • Proven ability to build pipelines from scratch using proactive sourcing techniques.
  • Hands-on experience with Boolean search, LinkedIn sourcing, and ATS tools.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote, fast-paced environment.


Nice to Have

  • Experience helping to build or scale a sourcing function.
  • Familiarity with market mapping and talent intelligence.
  • Experience working closely with recruiters in high-growth environments.


Other Traits

  • Proactive and curious, with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and evolving priorities.
  • Collaborative mindset and strong stakeholder partnership skills.
  • Passion for continuous improvement in sourcing strategies and processes.


Why Join Kake?

Kake is a remote-first company with a global community — fully believing that it’s not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. We provide top-tier engineering teams to support some of the world’s most innovative companies, and we’ve built a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive. We’re proud to be more than just a stop along the way in your career — we’re the destination.The icing on the Kake:


  • Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally.
  • Fully Remote – Simply put, we trust you.
  • Better Me Fund – We invest in your personal growth and passions.
  • Compassion is Badass – Join a community that invests in social good.

title: Remote Business Analyst (Portuguese) - 54880
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles



Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Remote Data Scientist (ML) - 52621
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We’re looking for a Data Scientist who has excellent hands on Python skills and Machine Learning experience — someone who lives and breathes code, optimizes for performance, and has proven mastery on competitive programming or data challenge platforms like LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle . In this role you will be working with Turing team members and AI researchers at Frontier Labs to devise techniques and build data sets to improve performance of models.


What You’ll Do:

  • Build, test, and optimize high-performance Python systems used in large-scale AI and data pipelines.
  • Design and maintain modular, clean, and production-ready Python codebases.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (data, infra, and research engineers) to deliver reliable backend components.
  • Write efficient, maintainable, and testable code with strong focus on algorithms and data structures .
  • Stay current with modern Python tools, frameworks, ML advancements and best practices.


Required Qualifications:
