title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Project Description:

The primary goal of the project is the modernization, maintenance and development of an eCommerce platform for a big US-based retail company, serving millions of omnichannel customers each week.


Solutions are delivered by several Product Teams focused on different domains - Customer, Loyalty, Search and Browse, Data Integration, Cart.


Current overriding priorities are new brands onboarding, re-architecture, database migrations, migration of microservices to a unified cloud-native solution without any disruption to business.


Responsibilities:

We are looking for Data Engineer who will be responsible for designing a solution for a big retail company. The main focus is to support processing of big data volumes and integrate solution to current architecture.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • Strong, recent hands-on expertise with Azure Data Factory and Synapse is a must (3+ years).
  • Strong expertise in designing and implementing data models, including conceptual, logical, and physical data models, to support efficient data storage and retrieval.
  • Hands-on experience with Power BI, including data modeling, report and dashboard development, and building interactive, business-ready visualizations based on enterprise data sources.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure, including Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, and Azure Databricks, pySpark for building scalable and reliable data solutions.
  • Extensive experience with building robust and scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from various sources into data lakes or data warehouses.
  • Ability to integrate data from disparate sources, including databases, APIs, and external data providers, using appropriate techniques such as API integration or message queuing.
  • Proficiency in designing and implementing data warehousing solutions (dimensional modeling, star schemas, Data Mesh, Data/Delta Lakehouse, Data Vault)
  • Proficiency in SQL to perform complex queries, data transformations, and performance tuning on cloud-based data storages.
  • Experience integrating metadata and governance processes into cloud-based data platforms
  • Certification in Azure, Databricks, or other relevant technologies is an added advantage
  • Experience with cloud-based analytical databases.
  • Experience with Azure MI, Azure Database for Postgres, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Analysis Services, and Informix.
  • Experience with Python and Python-based ETL tools.
  • Experience with shell scripting in Bash, Unix or windows shell is preferable.

title: Formulation Scientist
description:
Position Summary


The role will provide technical support for local laboratory work, with a primary focus on formulation development to support customer projects, the promotion of Vantage™ products, and customer events. Responsibilities include preparing reports and applying Vantage™ raw materials in formulations, with the goal of providing practical tools for the sales force and supporting strategic customers in the region.


The Research Scientist – Formulation & Application will be a science-driven project leader, responsible for planning, managing, supporting, and executing formulation and product development projects in LATAM, with a special emphasis on Brazil. This role will work closely with global R&D and Marketing teams, ideating, identifying, and developing new products for market launch, contributing to the growth of Vantage Personal Care in LATAM and globally.


Key responsibilities include developing formulations for major customers and evaluating their performance to demonstrate the benefits of our technologies, developing new personal care applications, and creating market-relevant concepts that promote Vantage™ technologies through marketing campaigns, customer events, trade shows, and industry activities. In addition, this role will design and perform (or coordinate) the necessary

performance tests to demonstrate and reinforce the value proposition of Vantage™ technologies.


Position Scope


The position will be located in Brasil.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities


· Development of new formulations to highlight ingredients from Vantage portfolio and their added values in formulation (skin care, hair care, makeup, and toiletries applications) according to internal and external needs, such as Marketing campaigns, trade shows, customers events and needs etc.

· Support in tests for performance studies and sensorial tests for costumer projects.

· Contribute to new product development projects to improve VPC product portfolio, including discovering new products based on market trends and customers feedback, assessing technical feasibility, developing the new product, designing and conducting needed performance tests to improve the product design, and finalizing product specs, etc.

· Monitor stability testing of formulations: organoleptic and physicochemical analyses.

· Qualification of Vantage ingredients and issue the report with the results.

· Ensure the efficient operation of the laboratory (respect for SOPs, raw materials and packaging inventory management…).

· Use knowledge of routine laboratory safety procedures, SDS’s and interpretations of hazards/toxicity data to perform all laboratory work in accordance with the written safety manual and site safety policies.

· Be a steward for safety and continually drive awareness to ensure a safe work environment for all employees.

· Understand formulation procedures and technologies and incorporate this understanding into applications that add value to customer products.

· Maintain accurate records of all laboratory work and research in accordance with generally accepted laboratory principles.

· Manage the calibration and maintenance of laboratory equipment.


Note: The duties listed above are not all inclusive and may be subject to periodic updating or revision.


Education & Experience:


Education: Bachelor of Chemistry, Pharmacobiology, Cosmetics Technology, Pharmacy or related areas, linked to sciences (Chemistry).


Experience: between 5 to 8 years’ working experience in the cosmetics and chemical industry.




Knowledge, Skills, & Talents


· Spanish and English speaker.

· Knowledge of development Personal Care products (Formulation & process).

· Being responsible, organized, proactive, problem-solving, easy to work in a team are characteristics inherent to the vacancy profile

· Ability to apply logical and scientific thinking to a wide range of intellectual and practical problems.

· Ability to influence and work in cross functional teams.

· Excellent communication skills (oral and written) and interpersonal skills.

· Natural collaborator, contributing to a positive team dynamic.

· Continuous improvement mindset, always seeking opportunities to optimize processes.



Working Conditions


Hybrid model

description:
About Us:

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


The Role:

As Vendry’s Accounts Receivable Specialist , you’ll play a crucial operational and financial role ensuring that our revenue engine runs smoothly, accurately, and transparently. You’ll be responsible for managing our referral fee collection process—working directly with our agency partners to confirm contract terms, validate deal data, and ensure timely and accurate payments.


Beyond the core AR workflow, this role is also instrumental in strengthening Vendry’s internal financial operations. You’ll support our accounting processes, help categorize transactions correctly, maintain clean records across our systems, assist with P&L and reporting needs, and identify opportunities to streamline and improve how we operate as an organization.


This is a highly collaborative role that sits at the intersection of finance, operations, and partner relations. You’ll be a key part of ensuring Vendry is running efficiently, sustainably, and with complete clarity into our financial performance.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage the end-to-end accounts receivable process, including tracking referral-fee–eligible deals and verifying all contract and payment data with agency partners.
  • Collaborate with agencies to collect invoices, confirm terms, and reconcile discrepancies quickly and professionally.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure all transactions are properly categorized in accounting systems.
  • Support monthly P&Ls, reporting workflows, and ad-hoc financial analysis as needed.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve Vendry’s internal financial processes, tools, and documentation.
  • Work closely with the Agency Operations and Leadership teams to ensure alignment between deal data, contract terms, and revenue expectations.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation in our internal systems to support transparency, compliance, and decision-making.
  • Assist with broader operational improvements as Vendry scales—including identifying bottlenecks, proposing solutions, and helping implement them.


Qualifications:


  • 2–4 years of experience in accounts receivable, financial operations, accounting support, or a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and AR best practices.
  • Excellent English proficiency (verbal and written) and strong communication skills, especially when working with U.S.-based teams and partners.
  • Experience working with U.S. startups, agencies, or marketing organizations is strongly preferred.
  • Comfort working with financial tools, spreadsheets, accounting platforms, and internal operations systems.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—able to manage multiple workflows with accuracy and follow-through.
  • Experience working remotely; able to collaborate asynchronously and manage your own schedule effectively.
  • Based in Brazil and able to work full-time remotely.


Why Join Vendry:

Joining Vendry means becoming part of a fast-growing team committed to transforming how brands discover and work with top-tier agencies. You’ll play a foundational role in strengthening the systems that allow our business to scale—helping ensure our financial engine is accurate, efficient, and ready for growth.


We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values operational excellence, clear communication, and initiative. You’ll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact on how the company runs day-to-day, while building deep experience in finance and operations within a modern, tech-powered startup.


If you’re detail-driven, process-oriented, and excited about supporting a high-growth company through strong financial operations, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Agent for corporate FX payments
description:
About FXRails


FXRails is a cross-border payments platform specializing in FX payments from and to LatAm markets. We enable businesses to move funds seamlessly and compliantly, bridging the gap between global liquidity and local settlement. We leverage stablecoin rails for fast and cost efficient execution.


Role Description 


We are seeking established finance professionals who have an existing corporate customer base that frequently transacts payments in foreign currencies. These include payments for imports, dividend payments, consultancy invoices or PSPs paying international merchants or investment flows. 


Key Responsibilities 


  • Leverage existing relationships.
  • Explain FXRails payment flow and key advantages.
  • Onboard partners for KYB and AML to satisfy regulatory requirements.
  • Build regular flows.


Remuneration

FX Rails pays a generous % commission that rewards payment flows and increases with recurring customers and targets met.


Qualifications 


Must Have:  

  • 5+ years of experience in payments, fintech, or international trade finance in LatAm. 
  • Strong network with local corporate customers, PSPs and fintech companies.


Nice to Have:

  • Background in selling to enterprise corporates or large distributor networks. 
  • Demonstrated success in driving cross-border flows in regulated environments. 
  • Prior experience at a global PSP, EMI, or international remittance company.

title: [TAG] Software Engineer Pleno - ServiceNow
description:
Quem é a Tag?

Na TAG, acreditamos que o conhecimento aplicável é capaz de revolucionar o mercado financeiro e torná-lo mais transparente, acessível e inclusivo. E é por isso que aqui oferecemos soluções tecnológicas para registrar o volume financeiro que o estabelecimento comercial tem a receber pela venda no cartão dos seus produtos e serviços, promovendo o acesso democrático ao crédito e ajudando a fomentar novos negócios por todo o país.


Aqui, você vai trabalhar com um time apaixonado por desafios, que respira tecnologia no dia a dia e é referência no mercado por inovação e expertise. Tudo isso de forma 100% remota, em home office. Quer saber como funciona uma Registradora de Recebíveis? Acesse nosso site.


Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.


Modelo de trabalho: 100% remoto

Regime: CLT


O que buscamos:

  • Experiência sólida com Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Actions e GlideRecord.
  • Conhecimento de Flow Designer, IntegrationHub e REST APIs (RESTMessageV2).
  • Capacidade de criar e manter Widgets personalizados no Service Portal (HTML, AngularJS, Client/Server Script).
  • Entendimento de ACLs, roles e segurança de dados.
  • Vivência com CSM, ITSM, com visão de processo e integração.
  • Saber estruturar automação real, não só montar fluxos.
  • Experiência com Workspace / UI Builder (Polaris)
  • Integrações complexas (Slack, Twilio, Datadog, Azure, etc.)
  • Noções de versionamento e boas práticas de governança.
  • Capacidade de propor soluções técnicas e colaborar em projetos de melhoria e automação de processos
  • Perfil proativo, colaborativo e com vontade de crescer junto com o time.

title: Global Training & Development Manager
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role

We’re looking for a Training & Development leader who drives real impact. In this role, you’ll design and deliver learning programs that help employees excel in their roles, accelerate their careers, and develop the next generation of strong leaders. If you’re passionate about learning that transforms performance and strengthens organizational capability, this is the role for you.


Responsibilities


  • Own the full lifecycle of training and development programs, from needs assessment through delivery, to strengthen workforce capability, performance, and productivity.
  • Assess skill gaps and business needs to design targeted learning programs that overcome performance challenges and boost workforce effectiveness.
  • Develop and scale programs that accelerate internal mobility, strengthen functional talent pipelines, and build leadership readiness.
  • Partner with business leaders to ensure learning initiatives align with department goals, driving both capability building and measurable business impact.
  • Create and maintain engaging training content for e-learning, virtual, and live sessions, with clear learning objectives and measurable outcomes.
  • Implement post-training evaluations and reinforcement micro-learning to ensure knowledge retention and consistent on-the-job application.
  • Track and continuously improve key metrics, including time-to-perform, new hire ramp-up, training completion and application rates, and talent readiness for future roles.


Requirements :


  • 8+ years of experience in Training, Learning & Development, or Organizational Development.
  • Deep expertise in instructional design principles and adult learning methodologies; relevant certifications are a plus.
  • Proven experience with e-learning authoring tools (e.g., Articulate, Rise) and Learning Management Systems (LMS) such as Brightspace.
  • Demonstrated success in designing, delivering, and scaling learning programs that drive measurable skill development and business impact.
  • Ability to understand complex or technical information and translate it into clear, engaging, and effective training content.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Highly organized, results-oriented, and able to work independently in a fast-paced, evolving environment.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • Make a direct impact by designing and delivering learning programs that develop global talent, accelerate careers, and drive organizational success.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Dotnet Developer
description:
About the Role

StaffingAbroad is seeking a Principal Backend Engineer/ Senior Software Engineer to join a #1 US-based FinTech & Crypto company . This role is ideal for a highly skilled backend developer who excels in C#/.NET and has a strong focus on writing maintainable, scalable, and secure code . You will play a key role in shaping architecture, ensuring system performance, and embedding best practices while working in a fast-paced and innovative environment.

This is a 100% remote, full-time role Salary $5.000USD to $8.000 USD


What You Will Do

  • Develop and Maintain Applications : Build, enhance, and maintain secure, scalable backend services using C#/.NET and integrate with APIs like Plaid, Dwolla, and Treasury Prime.
  • Shape System Architecture : Contribute to system design, ensuring performance, scalability, and security across FinTech applications.
  • Write Quality Code : Implement and test maintainable, well-documented code, with a focus on automation and software best practices.
  • Support Production Systems : Monitor and troubleshoot production applications to ensure high availability and quick issue resolution.
  • Collaborate Across Teams : Work closely with front-end, QA, product, and IT teams, while mentoring junior engineers.
  • Focus on Security and Compliance : Embed security best practices and maintain compliance with FinTech regulations.

  • Solid foundation in design patterns, software development best practices, and principles like SOLID and Clean Code.
  • Proficiency in C#/.NET, ASP.NET MVC/WebAPI, and Object-Relational Mappers (ORMs).
  • Strong understanding of MSSQL database design and optimization.
  • Familiarity with asynchronous microservices architecture and distributed systems.
  • Experience with modern front-end and server-side technologies such as Node.js and React.
  • Commitment to Software Quality :
  • Hands-on experience with unit testing, mocking, integration testing, and ensuring code coverage.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, particularly in Azure DevOps.
  • Proficient in version control systems, especially Git.
  • Experience and Education :
  • 6+ years of back-end software development experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field (preferred).
  • Collaboration and Communication :
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with team members and stakeholders.
  • Enthusiasm for contributing to a collaborative, dynamic team environment.
  • Cultural Fit :
  • Passion for innovation, accountability, and teamwork.
  • Alignment with a culture that prioritizes excellence in FinTech and Crypto solutions.


Plusses Include

  • Experience with iDesign architecture methodology .
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, including their tools and services.

description:

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver, treinar e manter agentes de IA baseados em LLM (OpenAI, Llama, Mistral, etc.), com foco em automação de atendimento, processamento de dados e fluxos de negócio inteligentes.
  • Criar pipelines de dados, integrações com APIs e fluxos de automação envolvendo ferramentas como n8n e integrações REST/SOAP.
  • Manipular bases de dados SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) para armazenamento, vetorização e consulta eficiente de informações.
  • Implementar lógica de context engineering, embeddings e integrações com vetores (Pinecone, Supabase, Weaviate, etc.).
  • Explorar e aplicar frameworks de agentes como LlamaIndex, LangChain, CrewAI (ou similares) para projetos robustos e escaláveis.

Requisitos:

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Python para desenvolvimento de automações, scripts e agentes conversacionais.
  • Prática com SQL para manipulação, consulta e modelagem de dados relacionais.
  • Experiência com APIs REST, autenticação OAuth2, manipulação de JSON e webhooks.
  • Conhecimentos em versionamento de código (Git).
  • Capacidade de documentar processos, escrever código limpo e colaborar em times multidisciplinares.

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento prático nos frameworks LlamaIndex, LangChain, CrewAI e engenharia de contexto.
  • Experiência em pipelines de dados e manipulação de embeddings (OpenAI, HuggingFace, etc).
  • Familiaridade com n8n (self-hosted), Docker e deploy em ambientes cloud (EC2, Railway, Render, etc).
  • Projetos anteriores de automação de atendimento, CRM, vendas ou integração de sistemas legados.
  • Conhecimentos de IA generativa, RAG e vetorização com Pinecone/Supabase.
  • Noções de front-end (HTML/CSS) para interfaces leves.

A Bluelephant é uma startup brasileira que transforma processos manuais em operações inteligentes com IA aplicada. Escalamos soluções para diferentes nichos em forma de SaaS (software as a service) e AaaS (Agents as a service).

Enterprise: modelo de projetos customizados para grandes empresas.

title: Exchange Administrator
description:
About the Role:

Our client is looking for an experienced professional with a strong focus on the administration and support of Microsoft solutions. The ideal candidate will have solid experience managing corporate environments and working with mission-critical technologies that ensure business continuity. This role requires availability to participate in an on-call rotation and the ability to communicate in English with global teams. The position is offered under a contractor model.


Responsibilities:

  • Administer and maintain Exchange 2016 and Office 365 environments, ensuring platform availability, stability, and performance.
  • Manage and optimize Active Directory environments, including security policies, authentication, and organizational structures.
  • Create, review, and automate processes using PowerShell to increase efficiency and operational control.
  • Provide advanced-level technical support and troubleshooting, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives, system migrations, and upgrades.
  • Be available to participate in an on-call rotation schedule, responding to incidents and critical issues as needed.


Requirements:

  • Proven experience with Exchange 2016, including maintenance, configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong experience with Office 365, focusing on identity administration, licensing, and end-user support.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Active Directory, including DNS, Group Policies (GPOs), and authentication.
  • Advanced PowerShell skills, with the ability to build and maintain scripts for automation and problem resolution.
  • Conversational English is required, as the role involves interaction with international teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a team-oriented environment.
  • Availability to work under a contractor model.


Preferred Skills:

  • Microsoft certifications related to the responsibilities of the role.
  • AWS experience is a plus.

title: Agent for corporate FX payments
description:
About FXRails


FXRails is a cross-border payments platform specializing in FX payments from and to LatAm markets. We enable businesses to move funds seamlessly and compliantly, bridging the gap between global liquidity and local settlement. We leverage stablecoin rails for fast and cost efficient execution.


Role Description 


We are seeking established finance professionals who have an existing corporate customer base that frequently transacts payments in foreign currencies. These include payments for imports, dividend payments, consultancy invoices or PSPs paying international merchants or investment flows. 


Key Responsibilities 


  • Leverage existing relationships.
  • Explain FXRails payment flow and key advantages.
  • Onboard partners for KYB and AML to satisfy regulatory requirements.
  • Build regular flows.


Remuneration

FX Rails pays a generous % commission that rewards payment flows and increases with recurring customers and targets met.


Qualifications 


Must Have:  

  • 5+ years of experience in payments, fintech, or international trade finance in LatAm. 
  • Strong network with local corporate customers, PSPs and fintech companies.


Nice to Have:

  • Background in selling to enterprise corporates or large distributor networks. 
  • Demonstrated success in driving cross-border flows in regulated environments. 
  • Prior experience at a global PSP, EMI, or international remittance company.

title: Coordenador de Ciência de Dados
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Esta pessoa irá contribuir com os processos de qualidade em tecnologia do Grupo Fleury por meio de técnicas, ferramentas e parceria entre os times de Digital e Tech da empresa. Fazemos uso da tecnologia e inovação para gerar a movimentação que o mercado precisa. Somos reconhecidos pelo nosso propósito: cuidar das pessoas e buscamos aqueles que compartilham desse ideal.

Deseja trabalhar em um lugar que concilie desafio, agilidade e inovação? Aqui é o lugar.


Principais atividades:

  • Coordenar as atividades operacionais da equipe de Data Science;
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de Data Science alinhadas aos objetivos organizacionais;
  • Participar ativamente nos processos de recrutamento, desenvolvimento de talentos e desligamento de profissionais;
  • Fomentar o desenvolvimento técnico da equipe, criando um ambiente propício para aprendizado contínuo e aprimoramento de habilidades;
  • Interagir de forma colaborativa com líderes de outras áreas para compreender suas necessidades analíticas;
  • Participar ativamente na gestão de orçamentos e recursos;
  • Relatar os resultados para a gerência e propor melhorias;
  • Tomar decisões estratégicas relacionadas ao direcionamento de projetos de Data Science.


Buscamos alguém que apresente:


  • Necessário graduação completa;
  • Desejável Pós-graduação, mestrado ou doutorado desejável em Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Engenharia ou área correlata.
  • Conhecimento avançado de técnicas de IA aplicada, incluindo IA Generativa, modelos preditivos e agents.
  • Necessário experiência em liderança, desenvolvimento de talentos e orçamento;
  • Necessário experiência em gestão de projetos de dados;
  • Necessário experiência em técnicas, linguagens e ferramentas de aprendizado de máquina e Data Science, como Python, R, frameworks de IA e Machine Learning, Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly, TensorFlow, XGBoost, LightGBM, Kubeflow, entre outros;
  • Necessário experiência em aplicação de métodos estatísticos e análise preditiva;
  • Necessário experiência em desenvolvimento de pipelines para análise e interpretação de dados, aplicação e produção de algoritmos de IA tradicional, IA generativa e Agentes de IA.
  • Desejável ter atuado utilizando ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Jira, Project);
  • Desejável experiência em Cloud providers;
  • Desejável experiência em práticas de governança de dados e conformidade com regulamentações de privacidade, como GDPR.
  • Desejável experiência em medidas de segurança de dados para proteger a integridade e a confidencialidade das informações.
  • Desejável domínio do Pacote Office e inglês intermediário..


Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:


• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

• Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;

• Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;

• Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;

• Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;

• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.


Informações da vaga:

Modelo de Trabalho: 100%Home Office

Carga Horária: 220h

Escala: 5x2

Horário de Trabalho: segunda a sexta das 08h às 17h48


Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!


Saúde e Bem-estar:

• Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

• Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;

• Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;

• Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;

• Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;

• Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.


Proteção e estabilidade:

• Previdência privada;

• Participação nos lucros;

• Seguro de vida.


Facilidades para o dia a dia:

• Vale-Alimentação;

• Vale-Refeição;

• Auxílio-Creche;

• Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.


Desenvolvimento e educação:

• Plataforma de ensino;

• Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.


Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.


Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.


Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.

title: [TAG] Software Engineer Pleno - ServiceNow
description:
Quem é a Tag?

Na TAG, acreditamos que o conhecimento aplicável é capaz de revolucionar o mercado financeiro e torná-lo mais transparente, acessível e inclusivo. E é por isso que aqui oferecemos soluções tecnológicas para registrar o volume financeiro que o estabelecimento comercial tem a receber pela venda no cartão dos seus produtos e serviços, promovendo o acesso democrático ao crédito e ajudando a fomentar novos negócios por todo o país.


Aqui, você vai trabalhar com um time apaixonado por desafios, que respira tecnologia no dia a dia e é referência no mercado por inovação e expertise. Tudo isso de forma 100% remota, em home office. Quer saber como funciona uma Registradora de Recebíveis? Acesse nosso site.


Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.


Modelo de trabalho: 100% remoto

Regime: CLT


O que buscamos:

  • Experiência sólida com Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Actions e GlideRecord.
  • Conhecimento de Flow Designer, IntegrationHub e REST APIs (RESTMessageV2).
  • Capacidade de criar e manter Widgets personalizados no Service Portal (HTML, AngularJS, Client/Server Script).
  • Entendimento de ACLs, roles e segurança de dados.
  • Vivência com CSM, ITSM, com visão de processo e integração.
  • Saber estruturar automação real, não só montar fluxos.
  • Experiência com Workspace / UI Builder (Polaris)
  • Integrações complexas (Slack, Twilio, Datadog, Azure, etc.)
  • Noções de versionamento e boas práticas de governança.
  • Capacidade de propor soluções técnicas e colaborar em projetos de melhoria e automação de processos
  • Perfil proativo, colaborativo e com vontade de crescer junto com o time.


Nossos benefícios:

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
About Us:

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


The Role:

As Vendry’s Accounts Receivable Specialist , you’ll play a crucial operational and financial role ensuring that our revenue engine runs smoothly, accurately, and transparently. You’ll be responsible for managing our referral fee collection process—working directly with our agency partners to confirm contract terms, validate deal data, and ensure timely and accurate payments.


Beyond the core AR workflow, this role is also instrumental in strengthening Vendry’s internal financial operations. You’ll support our accounting processes, help categorize transactions correctly, maintain clean records across our systems, assist with P&L and reporting needs, and identify opportunities to streamline and improve how we operate as an organization.


This is a highly collaborative role that sits at the intersection of finance, operations, and partner relations. You’ll be a key part of ensuring Vendry is running efficiently, sustainably, and with complete clarity into our financial performance.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage the end-to-end accounts receivable process, including tracking referral-fee–eligible deals and verifying all contract and payment data with agency partners.
  • Collaborate with agencies to collect invoices, confirm terms, and reconcile discrepancies quickly and professionally.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure all transactions are properly categorized in accounting systems.
  • Support monthly P&Ls, reporting workflows, and ad-hoc financial analysis as needed.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve Vendry’s internal financial processes, tools, and documentation.
  • Work closely with the Agency Operations and Leadership teams to ensure alignment between deal data, contract terms, and revenue expectations.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation in our internal systems to support transparency, compliance, and decision-making.
  • Assist with broader operational improvements as Vendry scales—including identifying bottlenecks, proposing solutions, and helping implement them.


Qualifications:


  • 2–4 years of experience in accounts receivable, financial operations, accounting support, or a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and AR best practices.
  • Excellent English proficiency (verbal and written) and strong communication skills, especially when working with U.S.-based teams and partners.
  • Experience working with U.S. startups, agencies, or marketing organizations is strongly preferred.
  • Comfort working with financial tools, spreadsheets, accounting platforms, and internal operations systems.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—able to manage multiple workflows with accuracy and follow-through.
  • Experience working remotely; able to collaborate asynchronously and manage your own schedule effectively.
  • Based in Brazil and able to work full-time remotely.


Why Join Vendry:

Joining Vendry means becoming part of a fast-growing team committed to transforming how brands discover and work with top-tier agencies. You’ll play a foundational role in strengthening the systems that allow our business to scale—helping ensure our financial engine is accurate, efficient, and ready for growth.


We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values operational excellence, clear communication, and initiative. You’ll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact on how the company runs day-to-day, while building deep experience in finance and operations within a modern, tech-powered startup.


If you’re detail-driven, process-oriented, and excited about supporting a high-growth company through strong financial operations, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Business Analyst & Scrum Master (supply chain)
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a Hybrid Business Analyst & Scrum Master to support the delivery of Supply Chain Analytics product teams . This role combines deep business and data analysis expertise with Agile leadership to drive insights, improve supply chain performance, and ensure predictable, high-quality delivery.

The successful candidate will partner with planning, logistics, manufacturing, and analytics stakeholders , translating business needs into actionable analytics solutions while facilitating Scrum ceremonies and team execution.

Key Responsibilities

Product & Business Analysis (80%)

  • Partner with Supply Chain stakeholders across Demand Planning, S&OP, Logistics, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Customer Service to gather and define requirements.
  • Translate business problems into analytics solutions including dashboards, KPIs, data marts, and alerts , aligned to the product roadmap.
  • Create and maintain analysis artifacts: user stories, acceptance criteria, BPMN process maps, data dictionaries, and data lineage .
  • Perform data discovery and profiling in Snowflake ; write optimized SQL (CTEs, window functions) and validate data quality against source systems.
  • Review Power BI reports, semantic models, DAX measures , calculation groups, and Row-Level Security (RLS) .
  • Define, monitor, and improve key supply chain KPIs such as forecast accuracy, inventory turns, OTIF, case fill rate, production adherence, DC throughput, and transportation cost per case .
  • Support data governance initiatives including metadata management, access controls, and data quality rules.
  • Contribute to analytics standards, best practices, and documentation.

Scrum Master & Delivery (20%)

  • Serve as Scrum Master for the analytics product team.
  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies: daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives .
  • Coach teams on Agile principles including transparency, inspection, and iterative delivery .
  • Maintain backlog health and sprint cadence; leverage velocity, cycle time, and burn metrics to forecast delivery.
  • Remove impediments and foster collaboration across business, data engineering, analytics, platform, and security teams .
  • Promote Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD) , test automation where applicable, and measurable sprint outcomes.
  • Communicate progress through roadmaps, dashboards, and stakeholder updates.

Required Qualifications

  • 5–8+ years of experience in Business Analysis or Analytics roles.
  • 3–5+ years of experience as a Scrum Master.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake, SQL, and Power BI (DAX, RLS, data modeling).
  • Solid understanding of data modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, and data quality frameworks .
  • Experience in CPG supply chain domains (demand planning, inventory, production, logistics).
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Must be based in São Paulo, Brazil .

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications: CSM / PSM , PL-300 , SnowPro Core
  • Experience with SAP, Blue Yonder, or Kinaxis
  • Knowledge of S&OP, APS, ERP (SAP ECC/S4), TMS, and WMS data structures and integrations
  • Familiarity with data governance frameworks (stewardship, cataloging, quality rules)

Tools & Environment

  • Snowflake, SQL
  • Power BI (Desktop & Service)
  • Azure DevOps (work management)
  • Data Catalog / Governance tools (e.g., Collibra)
  • ERP / APS / TMS / WMS integrations

Business Impact

  • Improve service levels, inventory turns, forecast accuracy, and cost-to-serve .
  • Increase analytics reliability, scalability, and stakeholder adoption .
  • Enable data-driven decision-making across supply chain functions.

title: Client Operations Manager (Remote)
description:
Company: Elite Virtual Assistance (EVA)

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Compensation: $2,000–$3,000 USD/month (based on experience)


About EVA

Elite Virtual Assistance (EVA) helps growing businesses scale through high-quality remote talent and disciplined execution. We partner closely with our clients to design workflows, train teams, and ensure consistent delivery against clear business goals.


We are hiring a Client Operations Manager to take ownership of client execution—someone who can translate client objectives into playbooks, manage day-to-day performance, and proactively surface insights through reporting.


This is an execution-first role , not a sales role.


The Role

As a Client Operations Manager, you will be responsible for owning the success of assigned client accounts from an operational standpoint . Your job is to ensure that what we promise gets delivered—consistently, measurably, and proactively.


You will work closely with:

  • Clients
  • Internal leadership
  • Overseas team members assigned to each account


This role requires strong organization, daily communication, comfort with data, and the ability to manage multiple moving parts without dropping details.


Key ResponsibilitiesClient Execution & Ownership
  • Learn each client’s business, goals, and workflows in detail
  • Participate in training alongside our team to fully understand client processes
  • Build and maintain clear playbooks for each account
  • Ensure execution aligns with agreed client objectives


Team Performance Management
  • Monitor staff performance, attendance, and task completion
  • Identify issues early (tardiness, quality issues, missed KPIs) and address them proactively
  • Work with internal leadership to course-correct when needed


Reporting & Data
  • Gather operational data across accounts
  • Create clear, structured reports (daily / weekly / monthly as required)


Client Communication
  • Maintain frequent, proactive communication with clients
  • Lead client-facing conversations with confidence and clarity
  • Ensure you fully understand evolving client needs
  • Anticipate issues before clients raise them


RequirementsExperience & Education
  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • Prior account management, client success, or operations management experience
  • Experience managing teams and/or service delivery is strongly preferred


Communication & Language Skills
  • High-level English proficiency is required
  • Must be comfortable conducting client-facing meetings, written communication, and reporting entirely in English
  • Ability to communicate clearly, professionally, and confidently with U.S.-based clients
  • Strong written English skills for reporting, documentation, and internal updates


Core Skills
  • Exceptional organization and task management skills. (You should have a personal system for tracking work and preventing missed tasks.)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Comfortable with technology, reporting tools, CRMs, spreadsheets, and dashboards
  • Ability to assess performance and translate data into actionable insights
Mindset & Work Style
  • Proactive, not reactive
  • Detail-oriented without losing sight of the bigger picture
  • Comfortable being accountable for outcomes
  • Able to operate independently while keeping leadership fully informed
Compensation & Growth
  • Compensation Range: $2,000–$3,000 USD per month , commensurate with experience and demonstrated capability
  • This position offers long-term growth opportunities for high performers, including expanded responsibility, increased compensation over time, and the ability to play a key role as EVA continues to scale.

title: Especialista em Integrações Oracle & Primavera
description:
Descrição da Posição


Buscamos um(a) profissional para atuar de forma estratégica na administração, sustentação, integração e evolução dos sistemas Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) e Oracle Primavera (P6 e Team Member) , suportando os processos de Engenharia, CAPEX, PMO, Projetos Industriais, Manutenção e Operações .


Este profissional será o principal elo entre TI, Engenharia, PMO, Projetos Industriais, Manutenção e Fornecedores , garantindo a fluidez das integrações, governança dos dados e a confiabilidade das informações críticas relacionadas a cronogramas, contratos, planejamento e execução de projetos .


A posição tem papel essencial em todo o ciclo de vida dos projetos industriais , desde a concepção, passando pela execução e comissionamento, até a operação.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Administrar, sustentar e evoluir a plataforma Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) .
  • Desenvolver, configurar, monitorar e dar suporte a integrações entre Oracle Primavera, Oracle Unifier, SAP, SDx, OSI PI e outros sistemas corporativos.
  • Administrar e sustentar o Oracle Primavera P6 e Team Member , assegurando a confiabilidade e integridade dos cronogramas.
  • Apoiar as áreas de PMO e Engenharia na identificação de melhorias de processos e oportunidades de automação.
  • Desenvolver dashboards, relatórios e automações relacionados a progresso físico, CAPEX, contratos e planejamento.
  • Garantir a integridade, disponibilidade e consistência dos dados trafegados via OIC.
  • Organizar e acompanhar incidentes, demandas evolutivas e melhorias , em conjunto com as áreas usuárias.
  • Atuar em projetos de grande porte , como ampliações, novas usinas, turnarounds e CAPEX estruturante.
  • Assegurar aderência às práticas de governança, segurança da informação e arquitetura corporativa .
  • Participar da definição de padrões de integração, APIs, conectores e modelos de dados .
  • Apoiar integrações no ecossistema Engenharia – Projetos – Operação – Manutenção .


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada com Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) , incluindo:
  • Criação e manutenção de integrações
  • Uso de conectores, mapeamento de dados e orquestrações
  • Monitoramento, troubleshooting e governança de integrações
  • Experiência com Oracle Primavera P6 (administração e/ou uso avançado), incluindo:
  • Estruturação de projetos, EAP e calendários
  • Perfis de acesso, segurança e unidades organizacionais
  • Publicação, manutenção e controle de cronogramas
  • Conhecimento e experiência com Primavera Team Member , incluindo configuração e integrações.
  • Experiência em integração de sistemas corporativos (SAP, Oracle, Hexagon, EDMS ou similares).
  • Conhecimento de processos de Engenharia, Projetos, CAPEX, PMO ou Manutenção Industrial .
  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.


Diferenciais (Não Obrigatórios)

(Modelo idêntico ao OSI PI – apenas diferenciais)


Engenharia Digital / Documentação / Digital Twin

  • SDx (Hexagon) – Digital Twin e engenharia integrada
  • Smart Review 3D (Hexagon) – revisão e navegação 3D
  • Meridian – gestão de documentos de engenharia
  • Smart Completions (Hexagon) – comissionamento e entregas industriais


Dados Industriais e Operação

  • OSI PI System – historiador de dados industriais
  • Experiência com sensores, CLPs, SCADA e integrações OT/IT


CAPEX, Projetos e Portfólio

  • Oracle Unifier – gestão de CAPEX, contratos e workflows
  • Conhecimento em governança de projetos, controladoria e orçamento


Manutenção e Confiabilidade

  • Isoplan – planejamento de manutenção
  • Sentinela / Iris Power / SKF – monitoramento de condição
  • Thermoflow – performance térmica

title: PM - (Especialista) com Ênfase em Produtos— Jornadas e CX
description:
PM - (Especialista) Ênfase em Produtos e CX

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇAO : PJ


São Paulo (Pinheiros) | Híbrido 1x/semana presencial


Missão

Liderar a construção 0–1 da jornada , em seguida, da jornada combinada , maximizando valor para cliente e negócio com foco em adoção, conversão e margem — com discovery contínuo , experimentação e roadmap orientado a outcomes (sem visão waterfall).

Escopo estratégico

  • Definir proposta de valor por segmento (jovem, classe C/D) e por contexto (renovação, regularização, 1ª habilitação, reciclagem, pontos, parcelamento).
  • Integrar as jornadas às capacidades fintech do ecossistema (pagamentos, crédito, seguros, IP)
  • Desenhar a “plataforma de habilitação e regularização” com bundles, pricing, risco, compliance e operações .

Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir entrevistas, surveys, análises de funil e JTBD para CNH e Débitos.
  • Mapear dores e variações por UF/DETRAN , e restrições regulatórias/operacionais/dados.
  • Definir visão, North Star, métricas e alavancas de crescimento (ex.: taxa de regularização concluída, AOV por bundle).

title: Power BI Developer
description:
Position: PowerBI Developer

Location: Brazil

Duration: 6 Months


The ideal candidate will have 5–7 years of experience designing and developing interactive dashboards and analytical reports using Microsoft Power BI , along with a strong understanding of supply chain processes and KPIs . This role partners closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, and analysts to deliver actionable insights that improve operational efficiency and support strategic decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable Power BI dashboards and reports supporting supply chain functions such as inventory, logistics, procurement, and demand planning.
  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications, data models, and visualizations .
  • Build and optimize data models using DAX and Power Query to ensure performance, accuracy, and usability.
  • Collaborate with supply chain teams to define key metrics and KPIs , ensuring accurate and meaningful data representation.
  • Integrate data from multiple sources, including manual inputs, data warehouses, and cloud-based platforms .

  • Implement and manage row-level security (RLS) in self-service and enterprise reporting environments.
  • Conduct Power BI performance tuning and optimization.
  • Provide training, documentation, and ongoing support to business users, enabling self-service analytics.
  • Stay current with Power BI enhancements and industry best practices , recommending continuous improvements.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Supply Chain Management , or a related field.
  • 5–7 years of hands-on experience in Power BI development, preferably within supply chain or operations analytics.
  • Strong expertise in DAX, Power Query, and data modeling .
  • Proven experience implementing row-level security (RLS) .
  • Solid understanding of supply chain processes, metrics, and KPIs .
  • Working knowledge of SQL and cloud data platforms such as Azure Synapse or Snowflake .
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Microsoft certifications (e.g., PL-300, DA-100 ) preferred.

title: Gerente Regional de Prevenção a Perdas
description:
A AutoZone é a maior rede varejista de autopeças e acessórios automotivos do mundo ! Empresa Americana, estamos em plena expansão no Brasil, com mais de 150 lojas no país.


A AutoZone inaugurou sua primeira loja AutoZone do Brasil na cidade de Sorocaba em setembro de 2012. Nossa mentalidade de cliente em primeiro lugar e compromisso com Ir Além definem quem somos, tanto para nossos clientes quanto para os AutoZoners. Trabalhar na AutoZone significa fazer parte de uma equipe que valoriza a dedicação, o trabalho em equipe e o crescimento. Esteja você ajudando clientes ou construindo sua carreira, fornecemos ferramentas e suporte para ajudá-lo a ter sucesso e impulsionar seu futuro.


Com mais de 7.000 lojas em operação e presença consolidada em diversos países, a AutoZone é uma referência global no setor de autopeças e acessórios automotivos. No Brasil, seguimos em ritmo acelerado de expansão, com operações em sete estados: São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Bahia, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná e Goiás.


Valorizamos a diversidade e acreditamos em ambientes inclusivos. Todas as pessoas, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, idade ou deficiência, são bem-vindas para se candidatar.


O Gerente Regional de Prevenção a Perdas será responsável por:


Planejar e coordenar as atividades da área de Prevenção de Perdas e Melhoria de Processos, garantindo a definição e o acompanhamento das empresas de segurança que prestam serviços nas lojas AutoZone no Brasil, no Centro de Distribuição e na sede corporativa. Além disso, será responsável por gerenciar análises e propor melhorias nos processos das áreas de Operações e das áreas corporativas, conforme as demandas identificadas.


Atividades:


  • Gerenciar o mapeamento de processos e identificação de riscos e pontos de controle de possíveis perdas, para possibilitar decisões quanto a ações de prevenção.
  • Gerenciar estudos e implantação de dispositivos de prevenção de perdas.
  • Definir e implantar a padronização de procedimentos para organização de estoque da loja, e produtos em displays e prateleiras, a fim de manter os produtos sempre organizados e evitar avarias nas mercadorias, e perdas de produtos perecíveis devido a expiração de seu prazo de validade.
  • Defiir padrões de procedimentos em casos de danos sofridos por equipamentos, materiais ou espaços físicos das lojas.
  • Gerenciar a análise de perdas, verificando onde ocorrem, quais ações permitiram a ocorrência, a fim de investigar os tipos de perda, seja por desperdício, falta de segurança, de atenção ou mesmo por negligência e despreparo.
  • Definir e implantar ações para mitigar situações de risco, assim como monitorar os resultados das ações.
  • Assegurar o treinamento de toda a equipe de lojas, apresentando os processos, controles, mecanismos de prevenção a perdas, orientações sobre procedimentos em situações de furtos por clientes, colegas de trabalho, roubos, entre outras situações, assegurando que estejam em conformidade às políticas da empresa.
  • Gerenciar a estruturação de processos de inspeções periódicas, apontando situações de atenção como: sacos rasgados ou furados, embalagens com perda de conteúdo e contaminação, produtos expostos ao sol, chuva, calor excessivo, entre outras.
  • Gerenciar, em conjunto à Merchandising, os acordos com os fornecedores no tocante às trocas de produtos pelos clientes, evitando perdas desnecessárias.
  • Assegurar o desenvolvimento e implantação de controle detalhado no recebimento de mercadorias, por meio de um sistema de conferência e registro das irregularidades constatadas.


Requisitos:

  • Graduação em Administração de Empresas ou áreas afins.
  • Conhecimento no Pacote office, word, domino de Excel e Power point.
  • Experiência com gestão de riscos e emergências, auditorias e vistorias.
  • Desejável inglês avançado.

title: Client Operations Manager (Remote)
description:
Company: Elite Virtual Assistance (EVA)

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Compensation: $2,000–$3,000 USD/month (based on experience)


About EVA

Elite Virtual Assistance (EVA) helps growing businesses scale through high-quality remote talent and disciplined execution. We partner closely with our clients to design workflows, train teams, and ensure consistent delivery against clear business goals.


We are hiring a Client Operations Manager to take ownership of client execution—someone who can translate client objectives into playbooks, manage day-to-day performance, and proactively surface insights through reporting.


This is an execution-first role , not a sales role.


The Role

As a Client Operations Manager, you will be responsible for owning the success of assigned client accounts from an operational standpoint . Your job is to ensure that what we promise gets delivered—consistently, measurably, and proactively.


You will work closely with:

  • Clients
  • Internal leadership
  • Overseas team members assigned to each account


This role requires strong organization, daily communication, comfort with data, and the ability to manage multiple moving parts without dropping details.


Key ResponsibilitiesClient Execution & Ownership
  • Learn each client’s business, goals, and workflows in detail
  • Participate in training alongside our team to fully understand client processes
  • Build and maintain clear playbooks for each account
  • Ensure execution aligns with agreed client objectives


Team Performance Management
  • Monitor staff performance, attendance, and task completion
  • Identify issues early (tardiness, quality issues, missed KPIs) and address them proactively
  • Work with internal leadership to course-correct when needed


Reporting & Data
  • Gather operational data across accounts
  • Create clear, structured reports (daily / weekly / monthly as required)


Client Communication
  • Maintain frequent, proactive communication with clients
  • Lead client-facing conversations with confidence and clarity
  • Ensure you fully understand evolving client needs
  • Anticipate issues before clients raise them


RequirementsExperience & Education
  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • Prior account management, client success, or operations management experience
  • Experience managing teams and/or service delivery is strongly preferred


Communication & Language Skills
  • High-level English proficiency is required
  • Must be comfortable conducting client-facing meetings, written communication, and reporting entirely in English
  • Ability to communicate clearly, professionally, and confidently with U.S.-based clients
  • Strong written English skills for reporting, documentation, and internal updates


Core Skills
  • Exceptional organization and task management skills. (You should have a personal system for tracking work and preventing missed tasks.)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Comfortable with technology, reporting tools, CRMs, spreadsheets, and dashboards
  • Ability to assess performance and translate data into actionable insights

title: Head of Growth
description:
This is an ideal role for someone who wants to challenge themselves in a fast-paced environment and join a passionate, driven and fun team. We’re working with one of the leaders in D2C health in the market, Series C, growing 150% YoY, and looking for a Head of Growth to be part of the LatAm set-up (SP-based). Here, you will have the opportunity to manage big budgets and to use your own initiative to follow up on the growth ideas that you have in order to hit the targets that have been set. If you are a self-starter who is looking to accelerate their career and enjoys problem-solving, then this is the ideal role for you! As a Head of Growth, you will have the opportunity to:


Responsibilities:

  • Take full ownership of performance within your projects and campaigns, analysing data, exploring new opportunities, implementing tests and making ongoing optimisations. The idea for this role is that you will move into managing growth holistically for one of our major categories e.g. hair loss, weight loss etc.
  • Manage budgets to drive maximum returns for the business, in line with target KPIs, forecasting spending and acquisition volume within your areas of responsibility.
  • Manage paid campaigns across various channels e.g. Paid Social, SEM.
  • Collaborate with a high-performing Growth team in Brazil and the UK, sharing results and insights on best practices and performance strategies.
  • Develop internal relationships and collaborations with the rest of the UK and BR team, our category managers, customer insights, creative, medical and product team to understand our customers' needs & behaviours and to translate these insights into copy, landing page tests, creatives, new channel tests etc.
  • Ideate test ideas within the channels that you participate in - landing pages, creative, ad copy, bid strategies, pricing etc.
  • Ideate and create performance creative briefs for paid social channels.
  • Test and own new channels that we don’t currently invest in.
  • Build relationships with external vendors (Google, Meta etc..) to understand best practices, new features and campaign improvement opportunities.


Requirements:

  • 5+ years experience working in digital marketing with strong hands-on experience managing campaigns with significant budgets within Paid Social and Search Engine Marketing (SEM).
  • Strong understands a wide variety of digital marketing channels and how they all fit into the overall marketing mix.
  • Advanced knowledge of Meta Ads, Google Ads and Web Analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics).
  • Familiarity with other channels (TikTok, Twitter, Microsoft, Native, Influencers, SEO, etc.) is a plus.
  • Experience in creative briefing, ad copy and creators/influencers ads.
  • Knowledge of A/B testing, including landing pages.
  • Advanced understanding of data tracking, conversion measurement, attribution and incrementality.
  • Experience with high-growth and/or healthcare businesses is advantageous.
  • Fluent English (mandatory) and Portuguese language skills.


About You:

  • You are a self-starter who can take the initiative, lead a project, own the decisions and proactively look to solve problems.
  • Numbers-oriented, you are highly analytical and love working with data to drive insights and action.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, confident collaborating with multiple stakeholders and managing expectations.
  • Ambitious, keen to learn and ready to grow alongside a rapidly expanding business.
  • You are curious for knowledge, always asking questions, and aren’t afraid to challenge the status quo.


This role offers very competitive pay , benefits, stock options, and the chance to build something big with an exceptional team and proven product-market fit.


Note: We carefully review every application and will be in touch via LinkedIn or e-mail with candidates whose background best fits what we’re looking for.

description:

  • BS or MS in Computer Science or related technical field.
  • 5+ years of experience in hands-on software engineering roles.
  • Proven track record building and scaling enterprise systems using Python, AWS, Kafka, Postgres, and/or DynamoDB.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, possui presença global e reúne quase 30 anos de experiência por meio de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants .

Iniciamos nossas operações no Brasil em 2007 como DISYS e, desde então, atendemos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, nos consolidamos como uma das maiores empresas de soluções e contratação em TI, oferecendo serviços que combinam escala global, portfólio completo e agilidade tática , apoiando a modernização de modelos de contratação, soluções de workforce e transformação tecnológica.

Possuímos escritórios em Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP) , mantendo proximidade com nossos clientes e consultores. Somos também uma Minority Owner Company , com forte compromisso com diversidade, equidade e inclusão.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro da nossa estratégia e representam nosso maior ativo. Nosso compromisso é atrair, desenvolver e reter os melhores talentos, criando conexões reais e oportunidades consistentes.

Nossos valores — Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia — guiam todas as nossas ações.

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Nosso processo seletivo é inclusivo e aberto a profissionais de todas as identidades, experiências e trajetórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Você irá atuar em um cliente multinacional de grande porte , do setor de petróleo e gás.


Sobre a Posição

Buscamos um(a) Data Management Engineer para atuar no suporte, administração e evolução de soluções de Data Management em um ambiente global e multicultural.

Este(a) profissional terá um papel fundamental na estabilidade, performance e melhoria contínua das plataformas de dados, trabalhando com ferramentas líderes de mercado e colaborando com times distribuídos em diferentes fusos horários.

A posição envolve atuação técnica hands-on, automação de processos, monitoramento de ambientes e aplicação de boas práticas de gestão de dados para atender às necessidades de negócio e TI.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar em conjunto com um time global, colaborando com profissionais de diferentes culturas e regiões.


  • Administrar e prestar suporte a soluções de Data Management, incluindo:
  • ER/Studio
  • EnterWorks (MDM)
  • Collibra Data Catalog
  • Collibra Data Quality

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
Job Title: ITS Business Analyst (Analytics)

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Duration: 18 weeks (Independant Contractor) without benefits

Work Model: Remote

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled ITS Business Analyst (Analytics) to support a critical analytics and data-platform transformation initiative. The ideal candidate will bring 5–7 years of business analysis experience , strong SQL expertise , and hands-on exposure to cloud-based analytics environments .

This role will play a key part in application rationalization and data migration efforts , including the transition from SAP S/4HANA to Snowflake . You will assess current-state analytics solutions, identify data gaps, and support the rebuilding and repointing of dashboards and reports to the future-state data platform.

Agile/Scrum experience is preferred, though Waterfall experience is acceptable .

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather, document, and analyze requirements for analytics and reporting solutions.
  • Review existing analytics applications and support application rationalization initiatives.
  • Assess current-state SAP S/4HANA/HANA data sources and identify future-state data gaps as systems migrate to Snowflake .
  • Support the repointing and rebuilding of dashboards and reports to new cloud data sources.
  • Translate business needs into clear data, reporting, and KPI requirements .
  • Work closely with data engineers, architects, and analytics teams to ensure accurate and timely delivery.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or Looker .
  • Perform day-to-day SQL analysis to validate data, investigate issues, and support insights.
  • Create user stories, functional specifications, and process flows for analytics initiatives.
  • Facilitate workshops and working sessions to understand business processes and identify optimization opportunities.
  • Monitor KPIs and performance metrics to measure the success of analytics solutions.
  • Act as a liaison between business and technical teams to ensure alignment and clarity.
  • Support data governance practices to ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • 5–7 years of experience as a Business Analyst, preferably in analytics or data-driven environments.
  • Strong SQL proficiency with hands-on experience querying and validating data.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms and data warehouses (Azure and/or Snowflake preferred).
  • Experience supporting analytics projects with an understanding of data modeling concepts (hands-on modeling not required).
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies (Waterfall experience acceptable).

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with data modeling and ETL concepts .
  • Exposure to SAP S/4HANA or HANA-based reporting environments .
  • Knowledge of statistical analysis or machine learning concepts.
  • Business Analysis certifications such as CBAP, PMI-PBA , or similar.
  • Prior experience supporting large-scale data platform migrations .

title: Engineering Manager - AI Agents & Platform
description:
Engineering Manager - Agents

$ - $ + equity

Remote


This is not a traditional Engineering Manager role.

If you don’t actively use AI tools to build, test and ship software, this won’t be a fit.

If you do....keep reading.


We’re leading the search for an Engineering Manager for a fast-growing AI-native company building production-grade AI agents used by real customers, at real scale.


This role sits at the intersection of engineering, AI systems, and customer outcomes.

You’ll lead engineers, but you’ll also build, deploy, and own what ships.


What makes this different


You will:

  • Lead teams building and deploying AI agents in production
  • Own customer outcomes (automation rates, reliability, quality)
  • Make architectural calls across agents, workflows, integrations and evals
  • Turn real-world deployment learnings into platform improvements
  • Work directly with customers, product and leadership


You’ll still write code (perhaps with the help of Claude code/Cursor)

You’ll still review PRs.

You’ll still ship.


AI skills are a requirement


You don’t need to be an AI researcher, but you do need or want to be AI-native.


Ideally you would:


  • Be comfortable building with modern AI tooling (Claude Code, LLMs, agents)
  • Use AI as part of your daily development workflow
  • Understand how agents behave in production (evals, failure modes, reliability)


You’ll thrive there if you

  • Are deeply technical and outcome-driven
  • Enjoy ambiguity and ownership
  • Think like a founder, not a caretaker

Why do people enjoy this role

  • Real ownership, real impact

  • Competitive salary + equity

title: Data Analyst Sênior
description:
O profissional terá como principal missão atuar com foco em dados no time de Finance.


O QUE VOCÊ IRÁ FAZER:

  • Arquitetura e Governança de Dados: estruturar e manter o datalake corporativo com padrões de qualidade, segurança e versionamento. Garantir a governança e integridade dos dados que alimentam a Árvore de Indicadores.
  • Pipelines e Integrações: construir e manter pipelines de ingestão e transformação de dados (ETL/ELT) provenientes de todos os sistemas críticos (Zoho, Oracle OCI, bases de produto, ERP, etc.). Automatizar atualizações e assegurar performance e confiabilidade das cargas.
  • Modelagem e Cálculo de Indicadores: traduzir regras de negócio e métricas estratégicas em modelos de dados e cálculos consistentes. Criar e manter os marts/layers de KPIs corporativos (MRR, NRR, CAC, LTV, churn, CX, consumo de nuvem, etc.).
  • Sustentação Analítica e Dashboards: garantir que dashboards corporativos (FP&A, BUs, Growth, CX, Controladoria, Produto) utilizem sempre a fonte única e confiável.
  • Corrigir e evoluir indicadores conforme mudanças de regra de negócio.
  • Suporte Avançado ao FP&A: apoiar a construção de análises e modelos preditivos (projeções, sensibilidade, cohort, Monte Carlo). Fornecer estruturas de dados robustas para budget, forecast e análises financeiras.
  • Liderança Técnica e Boas Práticas: ser referência técnica para engenharia e análise de dados. Promover boas práticas de documentação, governança, qualidade e segurança da informação.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Formação superior completa.
  • Domínio de SQL avançado e Python.
  • Experiência sólida com datalake, pipelines ETL/ELT e orquestração (Airflow, DBT ou similares).
  • Forte conhecimento em modelagem de dados, governança, versionamento e data quality.
  • Experiência integrando dados de múltiplas fontes (APIs, CRMs, ERPs, bancos transacionais).
  • Vivência com ferramentas de BI (Zoho Analytics, Power BI, Tableau ou equivalentes).
  • Habilidade para construir e manter KPIs corporativos (MRR, NRR, churn, CAC, LTV, margem, etc.).
  • Noções de estatística e modelos preditivos (forecast, regressão) — diferencial.


BENEFÍCIOS:

  • Vale-refeição/alimentação: R$ 550,00;
  • Convênio médico Bradesco Saúde;
  • Assistência odontológica: Bradesco ou Uniodonto;

  • R$ 2.000,00 por ano para capacitação profissional;
  • Plano de carreira bem estruturado.

title: Exchange Administrator
description:
About the Role:

Our client is looking for an experienced professional with a strong focus on the administration and support of Microsoft solutions. The ideal candidate will have solid experience managing corporate environments and working with mission-critical technologies that ensure business continuity. This role requires availability to participate in an on-call rotation and the ability to communicate in English with global teams. The position is offered under a contractor model.


Responsibilities:

  • Administer and maintain Exchange 2016 and Office 365 environments, ensuring platform availability, stability, and performance.
  • Manage and optimize Active Directory environments, including security policies, authentication, and organizational structures.
  • Create, review, and automate processes using PowerShell to increase efficiency and operational control.
  • Provide advanced-level technical support and troubleshooting, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives, system migrations, and upgrades.
  • Be available to participate in an on-call rotation schedule, responding to incidents and critical issues as needed.


Requirements:

  • Proven experience with Exchange 2016, including maintenance, configuration, and troubleshooting.

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.


Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: SDR – Pré vendas
